messages:
alex: Heads up — onboarding sample app hitting weird behavior with embeddings/rerank. Several requests get a 200 but the vector length in the response is 512 while our client expects 768. Happens more when retry/backoff fires.
priya: :thinking: do we know which client (node/python) or which SDK version?
ajson: Node sampleapp v0.3.2 I think? I saw a similar note earlier but it was auth refresh causing partial body send.
alex: Node sampleapp (local dev). Repro steps: 1) send 10-item batch to /embeddings (rerank flow) 2) force transient auth error (expired token) 3) SDK does refresh + retry 4) sometimes one of the items in response has vec length 512 while others 768. Logs attached inline below.
sam: can you paste the request payload and raw response? might be a framing/concat bug in the batching helper.
alex: payload snippet:
```
{"inputs":["q1","q2","q3",...],"model":"open-embedding-1"}
```
raw response excerpt (trimmed):
```
{"data":[{"id":0,"embedding":[...512 floats...]},{"id":1,"embedding":[...768 floats...]},...],"model":"open-embedding-1"}
```
priya: interesting that vector size flips mid-stream. SDK should validate shape and fail the whole batch. Are we normalizing lengths on server side?
ajson: server expects a fixed dim per model. The runtime always pads/truncates but that shouldn't produce 2 different lengths in same response. my theory: during retry we received a partial response from previous job that used a different model (older config) and the batch helper merged two responses because of connection reuse.
sam: that fits with an auth-driven disconnect. When token expired, client cancels stream and reconnects. If the connection's response handler isn't fully drained before we reuse the HTTP connection for the retry, we could interleave payloads.
alex: logs (correlation ids):
```
[3129991234] REQ id=abc123 -> batch size=10 model=open-embedding-1
[3129991235] RESP partial id=abc123 -> content-length:chunked status:200
[3129991240] AUTH refresh start
[3129991250] REQ id=abc123-retry -> token=:redacted:
[3129991255] RESP id=abc123-retry -> status:200 content-length:chunked
[3129991256] RESP combine -> observed payload: <interleaved chunks from abc123 + abc123-retry>
```
priya: oh no. That's a low-level http client bug then (stream pooling). Which http lib are we using for the node SDK?
ajson: axios + node's http.Agent keepAlive. We implemented a custom streaming parser on top of response.data. If axios reuses the socket while previous stream hadn't fully drained, parser sees leftover bytes.
sam: quick mitigation: add body shape validation in SDK (reject if any embedding.len != expected). Also add an extra drain/teardown on auth-refresh retry path (don't reuse the socket).
priya: Agreed. For short-term: PR to SDK that validates embeddings shape and raises an error before delivering to user. Also log a diagnostic metric when mixed-length batch occurs.
ajson: I'll open a patch: node-sdk#245 add shape check + fallback to error. Also add ephemeral change to Agent: set keepAlive=false when retrying after auth refresh.
alex: for product/console folks — this explains why some onboarding users saw "weird scoring" because reranker expects fixed dim and the mismatched vectors produced garbage ranks. Can we add a note in onboarding troubleshooting doc?
sam: yes, I'll add a short blurb under Embeddings > Troubleshooting: "If you see inconsistent vector lengths, update SDK to <ver> or disable connection reuse on retry".
ci-bot: deploy queued for branch node-sdk/shape-check (job 5423) :rocket:
priya: after the shape-check merge, we should run the sampleapp e2e with simulated token expiry to confirm behavior. Alex can you run?
alex: will run now, posting results in this thread in ~10m.
alex: quick followup — ran e2e with forced token expiry; shape-check caught 1 mixed-length batch, surfaced error to app. With Agent keepAlive=false on retry, no interleaving observed. Looks good.
priya: awesome. let's ship the node patch and follow-up on server-side guards. thanks all :tada:
